stages.title: Measure before making
stages.description: Lock the design; verify the real room and a sample connector before ordering wood or drilling.
actions: Measure the ceiling height. The top crate envelope reaches about 2,468 mm; 2,630 mm is measured.
Measure the room width at three heights, both diagonals and the right-wall plumb. Record them, plus every socket, switch, radiator and pipe, in source/room-measurements.json.
Measure seating stops, sleeve envelopes, saddle height and screw positions using the measurement fields supplied with the model.
Check the independent right balcony leaf, gathered curtain, real clothes and the 600 mm minimum entrance with a physical mock-up.
Confirm wall construction, anchors, clamp anti-rotation and desk/speaker load capacities. Choose fixings for the actual substrate.
notes: This is a checked geometry proposal, not a certified load rating or a drilling template. Do not cut the boards to these preview numbers until fitting measurements are entered.

stages.title: Lay out the kit
stages.description: Sort pipes by their printed catalog lengths, and keep similar-looking fittings separate.
actions: Use only the listed DOLLE PIPE family; do not mix generic plumbing threads or change a stock pipe length.
The BOM shows required pieces and purchase packs separately. Saddles come in packs of two.
Dry-fit one T/pipe/saddle/board connection. Check the end-cover fit; covers do not carry load.
Assemble horizontal pipe-and-fitting submodules while the T sleeves are free, then feed the upright sections through. Do not try to screw a rigid closed frame together.
notes: All sliding T pieces for a rod section must be staged before flanges, couplings or covers prevent them passing. Exact assembly order and fastener torque must follow the actual part instructions.

stages.title: Stage the lower uprights
stages.description: Lay out the ten main posts at their V18 positions. Leave the structure loose and supported.
actions: Lay out paired front/back posts 290 mm apart, using the model axes rather than the wall surface as a datum.
Stage the lower sleeves and braces before closing each 1,000 mm lower post into its coupling.
Use floor protection under flanges. Do not assume that a floor flange must be drilled into the rental floor.
Keep the frame braced or held during dry fitting; it is not self-supporting until its wall ties and braces are secured.
notes: The near shelf frame is 50 mm before the desk edge frame used in older versions. Keep the V18 axes; moving it back causes a pipe intersection.

stages.title: Build the shared desk supports
stages.description: Two front returns carry the desk edge; the existing shelf posts replace the short rear desk legs.
actions: Preassemble each free cross/front-arm/elbow module, with 40 mm pipe, coupling and 602 mm front leg. The cross-bearing post below uses 602 + coupling + 40 mm; above it uses 40 + coupling + 1500 mm.
Fit a four-female DOLLE cross at each middle upright: 250 mm front arm, 250 mm rear bridge, upper and lower stock upright sections. Join the bridge to a sliding T on the rear upright.
Use low 250 mm rear braces at 300 mm and front-leg braces at 400 mm, with a sliding T on both ends. Stagger them so two T sleeves cannot overlap; retain the low wall tie at 400 mm.
The current fitting profile yields a 689 mm support-pipe axis. Keep all eight saddle screw points on the 704 mm underside plane.
notes: No separate short rear desk legs. The two front returns finish below the tabletop; no front-leg holes are required. Leave the final wall anchoring to the verified fixing specification.

materials.name: Four-way threaded cross

stages.title: Fit the desktop and service shelf
stages.description: Keep the full 1,615 × 702 mm surface with a clear front edge.
actions: While the upper frame is still open, fit the desktop around the continuing rack posts and support it safely during assembly.
Transfer four post clearances from the measured frame. The preview uses Ø44 mm, including two open-edge notches at the near end.
Transfer the shallow underside tee/elbow reliefs from real castings. Do not break through the top face.
Round the entrance-side front corner to R100 mm. It widens the kitchen-corner passage; the nearest saddle screw stays on full-width timber.
Screw the desktop to its eight saddle tabs. Add the 1615 × 230 × 18 mm rear service shelf on two 250 mm T-connected pipes and four saddle tabs, at 500 mm underside / 518 mm top.
The service shelf begins 472 mm behind the front edge. Transfer its two rear post clearances and shallow T-casting reliefs from actual parts. Keep the central knee area open.
notes: Preview top height: 732 mm. This is derived from stock lengths and unmeasured socket offsets; it may change after calibration.
Kitchen-corner passage in the model: 666 mm, now limited by the low front brace on the near leg rather than the desk corner. Keep at least 600 mm.

stages.title: Complete the upper posts
stages.description: Feed the pre-staged upper sleeves before closing the upright sections.
actions: Ordinary posts use 1000 + coupling + 1200 mm. The two cross-bearing desk posts instead use the separate 40 mm riser, coupling and 1500 mm upper tube above the cross; do not run a continuous pipe through the cross.
Stage upper rail/cross-pipe subassemblies in height order before feeding the upper posts through their sleeves.
Keep coupling seating fully engaged; do not shorten or leave a tube partly threaded to adjust the overall height.
Leave the frame loose enough to square it, and retain temporary support until the wall ties are fixed.

stages.title: Square and brace the frame
stages.description: Tie the frame back to the wall using the verified anchor arrangement.
actions: Install the upper wall ties at their model heights. The near desk ties are at 1,200 and 2,020 mm.
Fit the wardrobe depth bars, including the low 200 mm bars and the 1,800 mm coat-end brace.
Check verticals and diagonals, then secure the verified fasteners and clamp settings.
Keep the bar and kitchen fixed. Confirm the kitchen-corner passage is about 666 mm in the actual flat.
notes: Wall material and permissible fixings remain to be verified. The model does not specify an anchor type or allowable structural load.

stages.title: Add the two short-clothes rows
stages.description: The entrance-side wardrobe bay keeps two levels of short hanging storage.
actions: Fit the 1,000 mm stock rails at 950 and 1,950 mm to their pre-staged sliding T connectors.
Thread both free T branches onto each rail before closing the upright sections.
Keep sleeves off couplings and clear of neighboring clamps.
Check real short garments on both rows before locking the heights.

stages.title: Keep a full-length coat drop
stages.description: The window-side bay uses the next smaller 602 mm stock rail.
actions: Fit the 602 mm coat rail at 1,950 mm.
Allow about 70 mm hanger drop and up to 1,500 mm garment length in the design envelope.
Four positions at roughly 140 mm pitch are shown; bulky winter coats may need fewer places.
Keep the curtain gathered and the right balcony door/handle sweep clear.
notes: The coat-bay width is a stock-pipe decision, not a cut-down 802 mm rail.

stages.title: Add the shelf cross-pipes
stages.description: Every ordinary cross-pipe seats into a sliding T on both uprights.
actions: Build the listed 250 mm cross-pipe/T modules before feeding or closing the corresponding post sections.
Match the model heights for the desk shelves, folded bay, top shelves and coat shoe shelf.
Use the correct shared cross-pipe where two neighboring boards meet.
Keep opposing saddle tabs staggered along a shared pipe so the straps do not collide.
notes: A saddle holder wraps around a horizontal pipe. It is not a substitute for an upright T clamp.

stages.title: Build the folded-clothes stack
stages.description: Four intermediate boards leave usable spaces for folded pullovers.
actions: Set the 606 × 350 × 28 mm boards at underside heights 700, 1,100, 1,500 and 1,850 mm.
Use four saddle tabs per board; transfer screw positions from the actual hardware.
Keep the paired folded stacks inside the shelf depth.
Check the 372 / 372 / 322 / 312 mm rear clear openings; the highest front opening is 272 mm behind the light lip.

stages.title: Cap the storage bays with wood
stages.description: The three top boards finish at 2,218 mm, before the crates.
actions: Fit the 1,004 mm top over short hanging and the two 606 mm tops over folds and long coats.
Use four saddle tabs per board and preserve the stagger on shared support pipes.
Keep the front edge clear for the removable light covers.
Top crates reach about 2,468 mm, 162 mm below the measured 2,630 mm ceiling; check the actual top shelf with a crate before loading it.

stages.title: Fit the low coat-bay shelf
stages.description: The long coats retain a low shoe shelf rather than a second hanging row.
actions: Fit the 606 × 350 × 28 mm board at 200 mm underside height.
Screw it to its four saddle holders.
The preview allows 100 mm shoes above the 228 mm top; verify actual boots and coat hems.
Keep the door-side area free of loose shoes and trailing garments.

stages.title: Build the three desk shelves
stages.description: The overhead shelves reuse the same main frame as the desk and wardrobe.
actions: Fit the 1,554 × 350 mm boards at underside heights 1,540, 1,880 and 2,190 mm.
The lowest board is 40 mm thick for the proposed MITTLED pocket; the upper two are 28 mm.
Use four saddles per board and the shared far-end cross-pipe.
Do not route the light pocket until clips, plugs, cable access and suitability of recessed installation are confirmed.
notes: The proposed 1,320 × 32 × 20 mm underside pocket is unverified. Surface-mounting the original IKEA clips behind a removable wood lip is the alternative.

stages.title: Float and angle the speakers
stages.description: Two side arms per tray keep the desktop free of speaker legs.
actions: Attach each tray to two uncut 250 mm arms, each on a sliding T at a separate upright.
Fit four saddle holders per 350 × 350 × 25 mm tray, using the rotated screw layout from the model.
Tray top: 1,125 mm. Angle each tray about 45.3° so the speakers face the seated ear reference (x 2,620, z 1,220 mm), not the seat centre.
Tilt each speaker about 10° down on angled isolation pads; the arm tees cannot drop lower while the posts keep their coupling at 1,015–1,027 mm.
Check real speaker weight, tweeter height, clamp anti-rotation and screw retention before loading.
notes: No load rating for this cantilever arrangement has been established. The desk-end placement gives a wide stereo angle, not a calibrated monitor triangle.

stages.title: Give worn clothes their own rail
stages.description: The throw-over rail marks clothes that are worn but ready to wear again.
actions: Use the two 200 mm returns, sliding-T outer fittings and 602 mm rail shown in the graph.
The rail sits at 1,250 mm in front of the folded bay.
Keep the draped item in the front 200 mm zone, y=3,950–4,150 mm.
Leave the rear part toward the balcony clear so the door handle cannot catch clothing.

stages.title: Close the ends and recheck joints
stages.description: Only close the post ends after every required sleeve and board is in place.
actions: Fit the listed upright end covers after confirming their actual fit on this DOLLE thread family.
Recheck every structural socket, coupling, wall tie and saddle screw.
Treat caps as covers only, never as load-bearing connections.
Remove temporary support only after the frame and desk fixing checks are complete.

stages.title: Light the work surface
stages.description: Keep the two original MITTLED bars intact.
actions: Use two 600 mm MITTLED units with their original mounting clips and compatible leads/driver.
The proposed pocket must retain at least 20 mm timber above it, with access for clips and connectors.
If recess suitability or service clearance cannot be verified, surface-mount behind a removable wood lip.
Route low-voltage leads away from clothes and sharp edges. Keep drivers accessible; do not enclose mains equipment in a routed pocket.
notes: Two 5.5 W MITTLED bars draw 11 W together on their own compatible driver. No LED strip is shortened.

stages.title: Hide the upper shelf lighting
stages.description: Warm light comes from intact ÖVERSIDAN bars behind removable oak covers.
actions: Use one 960 mm, two 460 mm and four 710 mm ÖVERSIDAN bars across the five upper lighting positions.
Use original surface clips inside the open-back wood cover: 18 × 40 mm front lip, 37 × 12 mm return, and removable end cheeks.
Leave access to the screws, connectors and seven intact 3.5 m fixture leads.
Connect the seven bars to the separate 30 W driver: 23.2 W total. Use ON mode for open shelves, rather than relying on wardrobe-door AUTO.
notes: Housing cross sections, clip offsets, local wood reliefs and cable access remain preview dimensions. Keep the existing main ceiling fixture off for the modeled night scene.

stages.title: Add the six crates and equipment
stages.description: Finish the storage without changing the locked layout.
actions: Place four KNAGGLIG 460 × 310 × 250 mm crates on top and two stacked in the lower folded bay.
Check that top crates can be lifted out below the measured ceiling and secure storage as appropriate.
Fit the reused monitor on the optional desk-clamp VESA arm at the desktop rear edge; no monitor stand fits behind the 61-key controller. Keep the clamp jaw clear of the router antennas.

Put the M1 Mac mini, router, and the router and dock power supplies on the rear service shelf; leave its front/back open and Mac ports facing along the shelf. The Mac mini M1 has an internal power supply, so the third brick bay is spare.

Fit the Focusrite and OWC dock beneath opposite front ends using adjustable open U holders. Keep front sockets/knobs accessible and preserve the central 700 mm knee width. Exact Focusrite generation and holder model remain unconfirmed.
Secure individual bricks without covering vents; route audio away from the brick bay and retain cable service loops. Check plug bend space and short tabletop screw lengths.
The shown dock-to-Mac route needs a 2 m certified Thunderbolt lead allowance; the supplied 0.8 m dock cable will not follow this route. Remove the cable allowance if you already own a suitable lead.
Keep the kitchen and bar fixed and use removable finishes. The TV is not part of this layout.
extra: Reused M1 Mac mini, router, OWC dock and two-input Focusrite
Two adjustable under-desk device holder sets (allowance)
Removable equipment straps and cable clips

stages.title: Walk through the real room
stages.description: A physical fit check completes the concept review.
actions: Walk the entrance with the chair parked and in use. Preserve at least 600 mm; the modelled kitchen-corner passage is 666 mm.
Open the independent right balcony leaf and check its handle, curtains, coats and worn-clothes rail.
Confirm all doors, drawers and the fixed bar remain usable. The bar has only 240 mm of leg recess.
Test the dimmers and cable access. Check load-bearing fixings with the appropriate installer before loading storage or leaning on the desk.
notes: The public model shows concept geometry and artistically balanced lighting, not a structural or lux certification. The bathroom is only a shell because its fixtures are unknown.
